name: github-better-latex
description: A Chromium and Firefox extension for rendering LaTeX in GitHub Markdown.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && esbuild src/content.ts src/background.ts src/copilot-source.ts --bundle --format=iife --outdir=dist --entry-names=[name] && node scripts/copy-manifest.mjs
scripts.build:firefox: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && esbuild src/content.ts src/background.ts src/copilot-source.ts --bundle --format=iife --outdir=dist/firefox --entry-names=[name] && node scripts/copy-manifest.mjs firefox
